text:
maria: FYI canary promote blocked, deploy-bot can't get cache lease for artifact build-859. CI job 859-merge stuck WAIT.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: lease_acquire failed for artifact build-859. Retries=6/10. Last error: "lease_acquire: timeout waiting for lock (s3-locker)", lease_owner: build-847

sam: Is this the s3-locker thrash we saw earlier today? Any global S3 throttles?

olivia: No S3 throttles in metrics. Locker appears to have a bunch of held locks. Could be orphaned leases from flaky runners.

cheng: grabbing locker status...

cheng: ```
# curl http://cache-locker.prod.svc/status
{"held_locks": 48, "stale_locks": 9, "uptime":"3d12h"}
```

raja: Oof. Stale locks=9 is high. Options: 1) manual clear stale leases (risky), 2) pin last-good artifact and continue, 3) rollback the canary.

maria: Change window is tight; prefer pin to rollback. Can we pin build-853 (last-green) for the promo and open a follow-up to cleanup locker?

aaron: I can run a one-off deploy-bot override to promote build-853. Will also add a release note indicating manual pin.

sam: +1 pin. Please record the deploy-bot override command so oncall knows what happened.

aaron: Command: ```
deploy-bot promote --artifact build-853 --override-lock-check --reason "manual pin: locker contention" --ticket 12345
```

olivia: :thumbsup: I'll file ticket 12345 for locker investigation and add logs to it.

maria: Thanks — do the override, then confirm once canary is healthy. We'll schedule a postmortem for the locker cleanup in the next ops sync.

deploy-bot: Promotion started for artifact build-853 (manual override). This message will update with status.

deploy-bot: Promotion succeeded. canary is promoting. Final status: healthy.
